useCases: Live plant condition monitoring — watch your plant's environment in near real time, so you catch problems before they turn into sad, droopy
Soil moisture tracking — know exactly when your plant is thirsty (and when it's been overwatered by an overenthusiastic plant parent).
Temperature and humidity readings — keep an eye on the conditions your plant actually lives in, not just what the weather app says.
